items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: Mrs. Vanderpool was a teacher in the Thomas Street School. I had to go to Thomas Street School.

ctx.x: So you took to the trumpet pretty quickly, it became your instrument.

Oh yeah. Yeah I took to it. And Mrs. Vanderpool was a teacher in the Thomas Street School. I had to go to Thomas Street School. And I think that was where I had my first school band experience. I was thirteen years old. Yeah, I took lessons from Chambroka , like I said it’s opposite Second Street in Rome. The building is still there, all by itself, right on the railroad tracks.
So you played trumpet all the way through high school?
